title: Fine but not great.
text: Wasn’t super impressed with this. The products that came weren’t bad, but they were also super neutral. I thought there’d be at least one with a real color to it. Plus I subscribed in February and it is now April 17 and I JUST got it. Had a chapstick, lip gloss, lipstick, liquid lipstick, and a nice eyeshadow palette. It just took way too long to get here and didn’t wow me quite as much as I thought it might, so I cancelled.
label: neutral
